explication: mm_radio is a FiveM role-play radio resource with a Svelte NUI. The main flow is player UI actions sent as NUI callbacks to the client/server runtime, which manages radio participation and updates the interface. The README also documents overlay customization, jammer behavior, battery support, restricted channels, and voice effects. The sampled source confirms frontend event and state behavior; implementation links for the Lua runtime and several documented capabilities are therefore left unverified.
